sources.title: What will the Mutual Funds do, if two or more installments are missed?
sources.locator: Mutual Fund Sahi Hai (AMFI investor education)
sources.excerpt: Electronic debits can be set up through “direct debit” facility or through NACH (National Automated Clearing House). … Just ensure there is sufficient balance in your bank account. … If you miss two or three consecutive instalments, the fund house may stop depositing the post-dated cheques and return all the unused cheques, or stop debiting your account. No penalty is levied and neither is there a forfeiture.
sources.limitations: General description of fund-house practice. It does not cover bank charges, the exact number of failures for a particular scheme, or how a specific mandate is handled.
